verdict.rationale: Kick's docs explicitly describe AI auto-categorization on transaction import (~97% first-pass accuracy), learning from user corrections, confidence-based gating leaving low-confidence items for manual review, and rules that override and persist AI categorization decisions going forward. This directly matches the founder story of automatic categorization with learning from corrections. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of the 97% claim and no detail on the exact mechanism by which 'learning' improves future categorization accuracy.
